applies_why: The judge text uses the absence of an exhibited verse/row stating a completed union as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED.
quote: the point remains open -- GROUND: no exhibited row states a completed union before the birth.
rule_words: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.
room: That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED: (1) absence of an explicit verse statement cannot support UNDERDETERMINED; (2) absence of any stated link can leave the matter open.
why: The judge's stated ground for UNDERDETERMINED is that no exhibited row states the completed union, which is the forbidden non-statement ground.
